_comment: 示例数据：虚构的 5 个词，用来演示报告长什么样。真实使用时词条由 AI 在批改时写入。

collocations: a resilient economy 有韧性的经济
resilient to shocks 能抵御冲击
words.example: Children are often more resilient than adults expect.

collocations: mitigate the impact of 减轻……的影响
words.example: Planting trees can mitigate the effects of climate change.

collocations: a trade-off between A and B 在 A 与 B 之间取舍
words.example: There is always a trade-off between speed and accuracy.

words.zh: 细微差别；（表达上的）微妙之处
collocations: capture the nuance 抓住细微差别
lose the nuance 丢掉语气上的微妙
words.example: The translation is correct but loses some of the nuance.

collocations: protect biodiversity 保护生物多样性
a loss of biodiversity 生物多样性丧失
words.example: Wetlands support a remarkable level of biodiversity.
